title: Estimator evaluation work
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and choose an input in $\{-1,1\}^n$ for each member of $\mathcal{F}$ and each of $m$ sample indices. For every $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the evaluation work of the resulting Fourier estimator hypothesis at $x$ is $|\mathcal{F}|(n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal{F}$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
